voice.rule: A letter the firm drafts for a client speaks in the client's voice: "We, [●] (the [role]), refer you, the [addressee], to the following:"; "you" is the addressee. A letter in the firm's own name speaks as "the Firm" (Ali Khan Law Associates (the Firm)).

cross_refs.rule: Refer to a provision of the instrument with its own word and, where known, its heading: Schedule W (Proposed Detailed Design Approval Process) of the Concession Agreement.

headings.rule: The Subject line is bold Title Case with small words capitalised: Subject: ⇥Alleged Unilateral Change Of [●].

defined_terms.pointer_formula: (Unless otherwise defined herein, all capitalised terms shall have the meanings ascribed to them under [●].)
defined_terms.rule: Bold in brackets without quotation marks (31 of 31 in the firm's letters); a document's title goes in single quotes: the instrument entitled ‘[●]’ dated [●].

header.text: [To be printed on [●]'s letterhead] — when the firm writes on a client's behalf there is no client header or footer.

salutation.text: Usually none; "Dear Sir," where the letter is personal. Never "Dear Sir/Madam".

opening.text: We, [●] (the [●]), refer you, the [●], to the following:

recital_limbs.text: the letter issued by the [●] ‘No. [●]’ dated [●] (the [●]); … ; and

reservation.text: This letter is issued without prejudice to all rights, remedies, claims, and defences available to [●], all of which are expressly reserved.

enclosures.text: Attachments: (bold) with numbered items; Copy To: (bold) with numbered items ending "; and".

banned.reason: The firm's letters close with the reservation line and the signature block, not "Yours sincerely".
source: letters folder (no complimentary close in any letter)

banned.reason: Figures in brackets are not zero-padded: five (5) days, not five (05) days.
